whenToUse: Comparing up to four candidates or options for one decision in aligned columns.
Showing only differences, marking the best value per row and deltas against a baseline.
avoidWhen: Public plan or feature comparisons — use comparison-table.
Viewing one record alone — use record-detail-layout.
a11y: Built as an ARIA table with row and column headers; the differences toggle is aria-pressed.
Moving to offer confirms first and announces the result via aria-live.
